description: Vehicle Miles of Travel by Federal-Aid Highways, 2000-2024 (VM-3) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual vehicle miles of travel (VMT) for the National Highway System, other Federal-aid highways, and non-Federal-aid highways for the states, DC, and Puerto Rico from the Highway Statistics Series table VM-3. Note: Missing 2009. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 6 columns, among them Year, State, Miles, Extent, Area, System. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
